name: Oorty by Sednium
description: Warm, editorial-styled multi-model AI orchestrator with zero-mock native on-device neural inference (GGUF & LiteRT), live hands-free voice mode, autonomous MCP agent workflows, and Obsidian-compatible Markdown knowledge bases.

changelog.summary: Oorty v2.0 introduces zero-mock dual-engine on-device inference (llama.cpp GGUF and Google AI Edge LiteRT), a complete UI/UX overhaul with Lucide icons, hands-free Live Voice Mode, thinking mode separation, and autonomous MCP device tools.
highlights: Zero-Mock On-Device Inference: Direct native bindings to org.nehuatl.llamacpp.LlamaHelper with real-time token streaming and tok/s telemetry.
Google AI Edge LiteRT Runtime: Native .tflite and .litertlm inference with XNNPACK acceleration and hardware thread pooling.
Hugging Face Hub Sorter: Format filter chips for GGUF and LiteRT models with curated on-device weights.
Model Loading Overlay: Real-time RAM safety check, loading progress, and 1.5-second success checkmark delay.
Thinking Mode: Clean separation of reasoning <thought> chains from primary response content.
Modernized UI/UX: True pill-shaped composer, cohesive Lucide outline icon family, and borderless assistant messages.
Live Voice Mode: Dedicated hands-free conversation overlay with dynamic audio waveform feedback.
Post-Response Actions: Copy, Share, Branch chat, Send to another model, TTS read aloud, and message edit/regenerate.
Autonomous MCP & Device Tools: Model Context Protocol execution loop with mobile system tools and extensible plugins.
